principle: Duties the plugin runs by itself on the computer that holds a role (lease confirmed on the remote), each at most every every_minutes, as a detached CLI run with --json. Only duties with auto true start by themselves; the others are run by hand until a person turns them on (they send messages to other computers, merge into the base branch, or write a story into the checkout). A duty whose command this plugin does not have is skipped. Commands check the role themselves too. AGENTIC_SDLC_ROLE_DUTIES=off stops them on a computer.
